static_traits.name: 梁淑芳
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因频繁寻求对编织的认可而紧张；有几位密友但not yet与其讨论自卑感受
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似的自卑感；not yet接受过心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, with fairly good logic; attitude negative, with strong self-criticism; willing to try but holds a skeptical attitude; tends to seek others' approval; feels embarrassed about discussing personal problems with others and avoids it

basic_info.main_problem: 因为在一次编织比赛中not yet获得第一名，持续感到自己是“糟糕的编织者”，引发显著的自卑与自我批评，影响工作专注、Interpersonal relationships与日常自我照顾。
basic_info.core_demands: “我只想感觉自己是有能力的而not是一个彻底的失败者。我想重新享受编织，not让这些负面想法压过一切。”；“这类not足感影响了我的自尊与整体幸福感，因此寻求咨询。”

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（在编织方面）
My worth depends on whether I win first place

special_situations.event: 编织比赛结果公布，not yet获得第一名
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not拿到第一名，就说明我的编织很糟、I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Putting great pressure on myself to perform, doubling practice to improve skills
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am such a terrible knitter / I failed

special_situations.event: Each time picking up knitting needles or thinking of this competition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次编织，就会再次失败，证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive self-criticism; avoids discussing with close friends to prevent embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will be terrible too; I will fail again

special_situations.event: Frequently seeks recognition for his knitting when interacting with colleagues, which strains relationships
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的评价决定我的能力与价值；如果他们not认可，我就not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断向同事寻求外部认可、回避独立评估
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我的编织not够好/看not起我

special_situations.event: 在not yet获第一名后回想投入的时间与精力
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果努力have not换来第一名，所有付出都not算数
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的努力都白费了，什么都not算

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为有能力并Gaining recognition（尤其在编织方面）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，导致自我价值崩塌与羞耻
defense_goal: 以高标准与Self-monitoring来避免失败
通过寻求外部认可来缓解not安
Avoiding discussing with friends to prevent embarrassment and shame

object_relations.object_representation: Others who will belittle her problems and consider them trivial

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to explore and restructure the rigid belief of 'must win', or to set more realistic goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing these negative thoughts are 'very real and hard to change', holding a skeptical attitude toward change
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和而稳定的语气，承认其感受的真实，同时将体验与事实区分；use具体例证引导其进行小步实验，避免对抗式说服。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被询问是否与密友分享这些not足与羞耻感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为编织问题“太琐碎，not值得谈”，从而回避分享
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopt a normalizing and de-stigmatizing tone, emphasize the impact of the problem on their well-being; use open-ended questions to invite recollections of the support that might be gained after sharing, and encourage attempting a limited degree of self-disclosure.

manifestations: not yet获第一名后感到“投入都白费”
Compares knitting with others' more serious problems, believing my distress is 'very trivial'
Self-worth depends excessively on external judgment (competition results, colleagues' approval)
Binding oneself with rigid rules such as 'must win first place'
Loses flexibility of choice under high expectations and high pressure

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Judging oneself by the rule that 'only winning first place counts as good'
Treats competition results as the sole standard of ability and worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: not敢与密友讨论，过度谨慎地管理自我暴露

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Uses 'knitting problems are trivial' as a reason to avoid talking with others about real feelings
When talking about failure emotions, turning to explaining the competition environment/judges' tastes

positive_force: Investing time and energy in knitting, with motivation to learn and improve
Able to clearly express own thoughts and feelings
Willing to try change with small-step goals
有几位密友可潜在提供支持
negative_force: 强烈自我批评导致Impaired self-esteem与回避分享

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent self-criticism and sense of failure (around knitting performance)
antecedent: 想到编织比赛及其结果
When interacting with colleagues and seeking recognition for knitting
target_behavior.core_reason: 将比赛结果与自我价值等同，形成非黑即白与灾难化的认知，进而引发Self-denial与羞耻
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与羞耻感、寻求外部认可以短暂缓解not安
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus、同事Relationship tension、Daily self-care affected，自尊进一步受损
